title: Control a real AI harness from Playwright E2E tests
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can wire Cordyceps into my Playwright tests with familiar interception and mocking controls so that I can exercise my frontend through the real binary within my existing E2E workflow.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Playwright test can configure a supported real harness to use the Cordyceps mock provider as part of its test setup.
Within the Playwright test, the consumer can intercept a request received by the mock backend and inspect its contents before choosing the response.
Within the Playwright test, the consumer can supply a text or supported tool-call response for an intercepted provider request.
The same Playwright test can drive the frontend and assert on its rendering of output produced by the real binary from the mocked response.
